name: Pagination
purpose: Present polished movement through ordered result pages with current, boundary, and ellipsis states.
useWhen: A result set or collection is divided into multiple ordered pages.

avoidWhen.condition: The controls move between guide articles, ancestors, or local panels.

composition: Choose exactly one state model: count with pageSize, or totalPages. Use Root for internal state or usePagination with RootProvider for an external controller.
Compose optional List with Previous, Items and Next. Omit List inside an attached ButtonGroup so the real controls are adjacent.
Use Items render for custom hosts; use PageText for summaries. Keep fetching, routing and result replacement focus application-owned.
For URL-backed results, provide Root getPageHref and derive controlled page from the current route.

rules.statement: Use Root getPageHref for URL-backed pages so controls are real anchors and native reload, sharing, history, and modified clicks continue to work.
Keep generated pages in a bounded inline row with List, or compose a compact summary and controls without hiding current-page meaning.
Use variant, selectedVariant, tone, size and radius for shared Button presentation; use Surface for container paint. Individual part overrides win over Root defaults.
Load styles.css or core.css plus pagination.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Rendering URL-backed pages as buttons, composing anchors while Root remains in button mode, or using Pagination for previous/next documentation guides.
commonMistakes.correction: Select link mode with Root getPageHref; use ordinary guide navigation links when page numbers do not carry meaning.

commonMistakes.mistake: Allowing controls to wrap into an unreadable grid or leaving boundary anchors live.
commonMistakes.correction: Keep the list in its owned inline overflow and verify boundary links have no href and leave sequential focus.

commonMistakes.mistake: Styling only the current-page background or using retired pagination container tokens.
commonMistakes.correction: Use selectedVariant and tone for complete interaction colors; compose Surface when a surrounding surface is required.

validation: Check first, middle, last, current, disabled, ellipsis, long labels, narrow widths, focus, touch targets, and RTL.
For URL mode, confirm real href values, reload, share, Back/Forward, Cmd/Ctrl-click, and inert boundary links.
Check count/page-size transitions, controller isolation, custom render hosts, attached seams, responsive sizes, localized numbers and PageText formats.
